---
title: "Solucionario: factorización, homogenización y racionalización"
---

## Parte I. Factorización

1. $$81a^2-100b^2=(9a)^2-(10b)^2=\boxed{(9a-10b)(9a+10b)}$$

2. Por agrupación:

   $$
   \begin{aligned}
   x^3+2x^2-9x-18
   &=x^2(x+2)-9(x+2)\\
   &=(x+2)(x^2-9)\\
   &=\boxed{(x+2)(x-3)(x+3)}.
   \end{aligned}
   $$

3. Factor común $5xy$:

   $$15x^3y-25x^2y^2+5xy=\boxed{5xy(3x^2-5xy+1)}.$$

4. $$4x^2+20x+25-9y^2=(2x+5)^2-(3y)^2=\boxed{(2x+5-3y)(2x+5+3y)}.$$

5. Como $6(-15)=-90$ y $9+(-10)=-1$:

   $$
   6x^2-x-15=6x^2-10x+9x-15
   =2x(3x-5)+3(3x-5)
   =\boxed{(3x-5)(2x+3)}.
   $$

6. $$x^4-81=(x^2-9)(x^2+9)=\boxed{(x-3)(x+3)(x^2+9)}.$$

7. Suma de cubos:

   $$27x^3+64y^3=\boxed{(3x+4y)(9x^2-12xy+16y^2)}.$$

## Parte II. Homogenización

1. $$\sqrt{3}\cdot\sqrt[3]{9}=\sqrt[6]{27}\sqrt[6]{81}=\sqrt[6]{3^7}=\boxed{3\sqrt[6]{3}}.$$

2. Como $\operatorname{mcm}(2,3)=6$:

   $$\boxed{\sqrt{3}=\sqrt[6]{27}},\qquad \boxed{\sqrt[3]{5}=\sqrt[6]{25}}.$$

3. $$
   \frac{3}{x-2}-\frac{2}{x+2}
   =\frac{3(x+2)-2(x-2)}{x^2-4}
   =\boxed{\frac{x+10}{x^2-4}}.
   $$

4. $$\sqrt{5}=\sqrt[6]{125},\qquad \sqrt[3]{11}=\sqrt[6]{121}.$$ Como $120<121<125$:

   $$\boxed{\sqrt[6]{120}<\sqrt[3]{11}<\sqrt{5}}.$$

5. Como $x^2-1=(x-1)(x+1)$ y $x^2+2x+1=(x+1)^2$:

   $$
   \begin{aligned}
   &\frac{1}{x^2-1}+\frac{2}{x^2+2x+1}-\frac{1}{x-1}\\
   &=\frac{(x+1)+2(x-1)-(x+1)^2}{(x-1)(x+1)^2}\\
   &=\boxed{\frac{-x^2+x-2}{(x-1)(x+1)^2}}.
   \end{aligned}
   $$

6. $$\frac{\sqrt[4]{8}}{\sqrt{2}}=\frac{\sqrt[4]{8}}{\sqrt[4]{4}}=\boxed{\sqrt[4]{2}}.$$

## Parte III. Racionalización

1. $$\frac{6}{\sqrt{5}-\sqrt{2}}=\frac{6(\sqrt{5}+\sqrt{2})}{5-2}=\boxed{2(\sqrt{5}+\sqrt{2})}.$$

2. $$\frac{10}{\sqrt{5}}=\frac{10\sqrt{5}}{5}=\boxed{2\sqrt{5}}.$$

3. Como $(1+\sqrt{2}+\sqrt{3})(1+\sqrt{2}-\sqrt{3})=2\sqrt{2}$:

   $$
   \frac{1}{1+\sqrt{2}+\sqrt{3}}
   =\frac{1+\sqrt{2}-\sqrt{3}}{2\sqrt{2}}
   =\boxed{\frac{2+\sqrt{2}-\sqrt{6}}{4}}.
   $$

4. $$\frac{4}{\sqrt[3]{2}}\cdot\frac{\sqrt[3]{4}}{\sqrt[3]{4}}=\boxed{2\sqrt[3]{4}}.$$

5. $$\frac{2+\sqrt{3}}{2-\sqrt{3}}=\frac{(2+\sqrt{3})^2}{4-3}=\boxed{7+4\sqrt{3}}.$$

6. $$\frac{7}{3\sqrt{7}}=\frac{7\sqrt{7}}{21}=\boxed{\frac{\sqrt{7}}{3}}.$$

7. $$\frac{1}{\sqrt{x+1}-\sqrt{x}}\cdot\frac{\sqrt{x+1}+\sqrt{x}}{\sqrt{x+1}+\sqrt{x}}=\boxed{\sqrt{x+1}+\sqrt{x}}.$$
